title: Duecare Grading Evaluation Wheels
description: v3.16 - wheels for grading-evaluation (A6, the lift regenerator). Bundled: duecare-llm-chat / -core / -models. Runs N curated prompts through Gemma 4 twice (harness OFF vs ON full Persona+GREP+RAG+Tools) and grades both with the universal v3.1 grader (17 dimensions, intent-aware, 106-source citation cross-reference, multi-signal matching) plus optional LLM-as-judge with evidence quotes. Emits duecare_lift_eval.json + .md with provenance tuple (model, git_sha, dataset_version). The +56.5pp number, regenerated live from a git SHA. Re-run after pushing v3.16 wheels to get the post-expansion number.
subtitle: Wheels for grading-evaluation - the dedicated lift regenerator with provenance tuple
